questions.q: Gerard cuts a large rectangle into four smaller rectangles. The perimeters of three of them are 16, 18 and 24, as shown. What is the perimeter of the fourth small rectangle? / Gerard memotong suatu segi empat tepat besar kepada empat segi empat tepat kecil. Perimeter tiga daripadanya ialah 16, 18 dan 24, seperti yang ditunjukkan. Apakah perimeter segi empat tepat kecil yang keempat?

Water makes up 80% of the mass of fresh mushrooms but only 20% of the mass of dried mushrooms. By what percentage does the mass of the mushrooms decrease during drying? / Air membentuk 80% daripada jisim cendawan segar tetapi hanya 20% daripada jisim cendawan kering. Berapakah peratus pengurangan jisim cendawan semasa proses pengeringan?

Teri is making a large square floor with a repeating pattern of hexagonal and triangular tiles, as shown. She thinks she will use 3000 hexagonal tiles. Approximately how many triangular tiles will she need? / Teri sedang membuat lantai besar berbentuk segi empat sama dengan corak berulang jubin heksagon dan segi tiga, seperti dalam rajah. Dia akan menggunakan 3000 jubin heksagon. Secara anggaran, berapakah bilangan jubin segi tiga yang diperlukan?

Nine cards numbered 1 to 9 are placed facedown. Aleksa, Bart, Clara and Deindra each pick two cards. Aleksa: "My numbers add up to 6." Bart: "The difference between my numbers is 5." Clara: "The product of my numbers is 18." Deindra: "One of my numbers is twice the other." All four are true. Which number is left on the table? / Sembilan kad bernombor 1 hingga 9 diletakkan menghadap ke bawah. Aleksa, Bart, Clara dan Deindra masing-masing mengambil dua kad. Aleksa: "Nombor saya berjumlah 6." Bart: "Beza nombor saya ialah 5." Clara: "Hasil darab nombor saya ialah 18." Deindra: "Satu nombor saya dua kali ganda nombor yang lagi satu." Semuanya benar. Apakah nombor yang tertinggal di atas meja?

50 students sit in a circle. Each student who gets the ball throws it to the 6th student anti-clockwise from where they sit. Freda catches the ball 100 times. In that time, how many students never get to catch the ball? / 50 orang pelajar duduk dalam satu bulatan. Setiap pelajar yang mendapat bola akan melontarkannya kepada pelajar ke-6 mengikut arah lawan jam. Freda menangkap bola itu sebanyak 100 kali. Sepanjang masa itu, berapakah bilangan pelajar yang tidak pernah menangkap bola?

Three angles α, β and γ are marked on squared paper, as shown. What is the value of α + β + γ? / Tiga sudut α, β dan γ ditandakan pada kertas berpetak, seperti yang ditunjukkan. Apakah nilai α + β + γ?

Captain Flint asked four pirates to write how many gold, silver and bronze coins were in the treasure chest. Their answers are shown, but part of the paper is damaged. Only one pirate told the truth; the other three lied in all their answers. There are 30 coins in total. Who told the truth? / Kapten Flint meminta empat lanun menulis bilangan syiling emas, perak dan gangsa dalam peti harta karun. Jawapan mereka ditunjukkan, tetapi sebahagian kertas telah rosak. Hanya seorang lanun bercakap benar; tiga yang lain berbohong dalam semua jawapan. Jumlah syiling ialah 30. Siapakah yang bercakap benar?
options: We cannot be sure / Tidak dapat dipastikan

questions.q: Alex drives from A to B, then immediately returns to A. Bob drives from B to A, then immediately returns to B. They use the same road, start at the same time and travel at constant speeds. Alex is three times as fast as Bob. They pass each other for the first time 15 minutes after the start. When do they pass each other for the second time? / Alex memandu dari A ke B, kemudian terus kembali ke A. Bob memandu dari B ke A, kemudian terus kembali ke B. Mereka menggunakan jalan yang sama, bertolak serentak dan bergerak dengan laju seragam. Laju Alex tiga kali ganda laju Bob. Mereka berselisih kali pertama 15 minit selepas bertolak. Bilakah mereka berselisih kali kedua?
